groups.note: Biochemistry and Cell Biology Electives (Courses from the specified elective list. Students following IRE Track are required to take a minimum of 12 credits; while others should either take a minimum of 20 credits (for those opting for LIFS 4971 & LIFS 4981), or 24 credits (for those opting for LIFS 4961).
